meta.title: Improve image flipper performance
meta.body_summary: Add image preloading to the image flipper so that flipping through photos is snappy, with tests and tsconfig updates.

perf_labels.notes: Image preloading PR with tests but no maintainer review or engagement; closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added image preloading logic in image_flipper.tsx and flipper_image.tsx; preloads next few images when flipping through photos to reduce latency. Added tests and updated tsconfig for jest-dom types.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file and tsconfig updates support the feature.
